name: mediabeem-agency-manager
description: Media Beem Agency Manager — 3-portal system (admin / employee / client) on Cloudflare Workers + D1 + Pages

scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply mediabeem-db --remote -c worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply mediabeem-db --local -c worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy: npm run db:migrate && npm run deploy:api && npm run deploy:pages
